# Field dictionary

Snapshot `2026-09-10`. One object per trial under `trials` in `data/clinical-trials.json`, keyed by `id`.

The CSV exports flatten the same records: array values are joined with ` | `, and eligibility bounds are promoted to `eligibility_*` columns.

## Top level

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `generatedAt` | ISO 8601 | When this snapshot was produced (`2026-09-10T17:36:37.610Z`) |
| `summary` | object | Pre-computed counts. **Read these rather than aggregating records yourself** — see [methodology](methodology.md#counting-conventions) |
| `trials` | object | Keyed by trial `id` |

### `summary`

| Field | This snapshot | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `trials_total` | 71 | All records, including terminated and completed studies |
| `trials_recruiting` | 70 | Only `status_code = recruiting`. **Quote this when describing what patients can currently join** |
| `centers_china` | 337 | Deduplicated centres resolvable to a Chinese provincial-level region (includes Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan) |
| `centers_overseas` | 217 | Remaining sites of international multi-centre studies |
| `centers_total` | 554 | `centers_china + centers_overseas` |
| `provinces_covered` | 31 | Distinct Chinese provincial-level regions with at least one recruiting centre |

Centre counts cover **recruiting studies only** and count unique institutions after normalisation. They are deliberately not the number of rows in `trial-centers.csv` (1510), which counts every trial × centre pair across all studies.

## Per-trial fields

Definitions below are generated from CMDN's canonical field specification — the same source that drives the `variableMeasured` block of the `Dataset` JSON-LD on chinamyeloma.org.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | Stable CMDN record identifier |
| `cde_id` | `string?` | NMPA CDE registration number (CTR + 8 digits) |
| `registry_id` | `string` | Preferred official registry identifier |
| `registry_system` | `string` | Registry system code (CDE_CTR, CHICTR, CLINICALTRIALS_GOV) |
| `cross_registry_ids` | `{system,value,url?}[]` | The same study’s identifiers in other public registries, with directly accessible verification URLs (beyond the primary registry_id) |
| `registry_status` | `string` | Registration tier: cde_registered / international_registry_only / other_identifier_only / unregistered |
| `title` | `string` | Official protocol title as registered |
| `status_code` | `string` | Normalized recruitment status code |
| `phase_code` | `string` | Normalized clinical phase code |
| `target` | `string` | Primary target or mechanism of action |
| `therapy_types` | `string[]` | Modality classification (CAR-T, bispecific, monoclonal antibody, small molecule) |
| `population` | `string` | Target population tier (synthesized by CMDN from public filings; not an official CDE field) |
| `locations` | `string[]` | Study centers after de-duplication and branch-campus normalization |
| `locations_count` | `number` | Number of participating study centers |
| `locations_count_china` | `number` | Study centers resolvable to a Chinese provincial-level region (incl. HK/Macau/Taiwan) |
| `locations_count_overseas` | `number` | Overseas sites of international multi-center studies |
| `url` | `string` | Canonical CMDN page for this study |
| `source_document_type` | `string` | Type of the archived source document |
| `source_pdf_url` | `string` | Direct link to the archived source filing (PDF); no login or token required |
| `updated_at` | `string` | Timestamp of the most recent CMDN reconciliation |

### Observed values in this snapshot

| Field | Values |
|---|---|
| `registry_status` | `cde_registered` 65 · `international_registry_only` 4 · `other_identifier_only` 1 · `unregistered` 1 |
| `registry_system` | `CDE_CTR` 65 · `CLINICALTRIALS_GOV` 4 · `OTHER` 1 · `(empty)` 1 |
| `status_code` | `recruiting` 70 · `terminated` 1 |
| `phase_code` | `phase_1` 26 · `phase_2` 23 · `phase_3` 17 · `clinical_study` 3 · `(empty)` 2 |
| `source_document_type` | `cde_registration` 65 · `clinicaltrials_registry` 3 · `other` 2 · `hospital_protocol` 1 |
| `population` | `复发难治` 53 · `多发性骨髓瘤` 12 · `健康受试者` 2 · `新诊断` 2 · `新诊断/复发难治` 1 · `新诊断/维持治疗` 1 |
| `therapy_types` | `monoclonal_antibody` 17 · `bispecific_antibody` 17 · `CAR-T` 16 · `small_molecule` 9 · `antibody_drug_conjugate` 3 · `三抗` 2 · `cell_therapy` 1 · `ADC` 1 · `单抗` 1 |

`registry_status` is the field most often misread, so it is worth spelling out:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `cde_registered` | Holds an NMPA/CDE registration number (`CTR` + 8 digits) |
| `international_registry_only` | Registered internationally (e.g. ClinicalTrials.gov) but not on the NMPA/CDE platform |
| `other_identifier_only` | Carries only an ethics approval or internal protocol identifier |
| `unregistered` | No public registration identifier found |

**A study whose `registry_status` is not `cde_registered` must not be described as NMPA-registered.** Investigator-initiated and internationally-registered studies are routinely misreported as nationally approved.

Two vocabulary caveats, stated because they will bite anyone matching on strings:

- `therapy_types` mixes Chinese labels with English snake_case, and `ADC` / `antibody_drug_conjugate` denote the same modality.
- `population` mixes granularities: some values are a line-of-therapy tier, one is just the disease name. It is derived by CMDN from public filings and is **not** a CDE registration field.

## `eligibility`

Structured inclusion/exclusion criteria extracted from the filing PDF, then human-reviewed. This object is not part of the site-facing field specification above; it is documented here.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `age_min` / `age_max` | number \| null | Age bounds; `null` where the filing sets none |
| `ecog_max` | number \| null | Maximum ECOG performance status |
| `prior_lines_min` / `prior_lines_max` | number \| null | Required prior lines of therapy |
| `inclusion` | string[] | Inclusion criteria, verbatim from the filing, in Chinese |
| `exclusion` | string[] | Exclusion criteria, verbatim |
| `source_page` | string | Page range in the source PDF, e.g. `"2-3"` |
| `extracted_at` | ISO 8601 | When extraction ran |
| `status` | string | Review state (`reviewed` on 71 of 71 records in this snapshot) |
| `reviewed_by` / `reviewed_at` | string / ISO 8601 | Review provenance |
| `verification` | object | Automated check that extracted items match the PDF text layer: `total_items`, `unmatched`, `verified_at`, `text_layer_available` |

**`verification.unmatched` is the field to look at before relying on eligibility.** A non-empty array means some extracted criteria could not be matched back to the source text — usually a scanned PDF with no text layer. In this snapshot 11 of 71 records have unmatched items, and 1 has no text layer at all.

Criteria are reproduced in Chinese as filed. They are a transcription of a source document, not a clinical interpretation of it.

## CSV columns

`data/clinical-trials.csv` — 25 columns, one row per trial:

```
id, registry_id, registry_system, registry_status, cde_id, title, phase_code, status_code, population, target, therapy_types, locations_count, locations_count_china, locations_count_overseas, eligibility_age_min, eligibility_age_max, eligibility_ecog_max, eligibility_prior_lines_min, eligibility_prior_lines_max, eligibility_review_status, cross_registry_ids, source_document_type, source_pdf_url, url, updated_at
```

`data/trial-centers.csv` — one row per trial × centre (1510 rows):

```
trial_id, registry_id, status_code, center_name, province_id, region
```

`region` resolves to `china` 1291 · `overseas` 219. `province_id` is a stable slug (`beijing`, `shanghai`, …) and is empty for overseas sites.
